capabilities.description: Synthetic vulnerable, protected and inconclusive API authorisation observations
Text and JSON module catalogue, search and descriptions
Structured findings with redacted observation evidence
Vulnerable/corrected loopback fixtures and documented CLI exit codes
Accepted F006 immutable module metadata and versioned results with validated identifiers, statuses, severities and operator-safe evidence contract
Accepted F007 explicit module registration and dispatch through injected runners, duplicate rejection, preserved registration order and matching result identity
Accepted T008 finite positive HTTP timeouts and exact positive integer response limits, preserving numeric-loopback scope and bounded JSON responses

requirements: Synthetic loopback fixtures only for autonomous execution
Do not disclose credentials or private response bodies
T008 requires finite positive numeric timeout and positive integer max_body, rejecting booleans and invalid limits before any request
F006 in docs/FRAMEWORK_CONTRACTS.md: frozen ModuleSpec and ModuleResult
Validate IDs, required text, categories, boolean flags, result status and severity
Serialize versioned JSON-compatible evidence without claiming automatic redaction of arbitrary caller text
F007 in docs/FRAMEWORK_CONTRACTS.md: explicit registration without dynamic plugin discovery
Reject duplicate IDs and invalid runners; preserve registration order
Copy caller options, require matching ModuleResult identity, and propagate operational exceptions
Future framework contracts remain plans until an accepted commit and checks establish delivery

metrics.source: saved required host-check receipts for the exact canonical head
metrics.definition: passed required checks divided by all required profile checks; unavailable checks remain in the denominator

metrics.source: declared shipped workflows and their actual check receipts
metrics.definition: workflows whose declared checks all passed divided by declared workflows; measures the synthetic coverage in this profile, not all real-world workflows

metrics.source: host-measured elapsed execution of declared workflow checks
metrics.definition: synthetic test-harness duration, not measured end-user product latency

metrics.source: open shipped-product defect and debt findings; exhausted repairs remain open

pipeline_metrics.source: indexed accepted-commit receipts and run outcomes
pipeline_metrics.scope: development pipeline; does not establish product quality

unmeasured_product_outcomes: End-user workflow latency and setup effort outside the synthetic harness
Real home-lab finding accuracy and false positives outside supplied fixtures
User-observed usability and comparative effectiveness against external tools
profile_update_rule: Coordinator updates and increments this profile after an accepted capability changes shipped scope, contracts, checks or workflows. Workers cannot edit the profile. Its content hash binds admission and promotion.
